transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... well, I got a little worked up at work. During a staff meeting. I started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill, moving chairs around, waving my arms. People told me to sit down, but... I just couldn't seem to stop. So, they wanted me to come here.
Did you think about what you were doing during the staff meeting before you started moving chairs and waving your arms?
Not really. I just... I don't know. I didn't plan it out or anything. It just kind of happened.
Did this incident at the staff meeting cause any problems for you at work or with your relationships with coworkers?

Yeah... they, uh, they put me on leave. From the senior center. So... yeah, it caused problems. 

I don't really know what my coworkers think. I just... I worry if I can even go back to caregiving safely. It's just been hard lately. I'm not keeping up with things the way I used to. My wife has to keep reminding me about chores and... appointments, things like that. I've mostly just been pulling back from people. Even my friends from church. I just... I don't know.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or urges that you feel compelled to act on?
No... not really. I don't... I don't think so. Just the regular stuff, I guess. Nothing like that.
Would you say you've been acting like yourself lately?

I guess... I don't know. My wife says I'm not. She says I just sit in the living room staring at the TV... with the sound turned down low. I haven't been calling my church friends or... finishing simple chores like I used to. Even when I know they need doing. I just... don't.
Would you describe yourself as having any unusual or prominent personality characteristics?
I don't think so. I'm just... me, I guess. I don't really know what you mean by that.
Have you been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless lately?
Not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I feel sad. I'm not crying or anything like that. Just... I don't know. Just kind of quiet, I guess. But no.
Have you had any significant problems with your relationships with family or friends recently?

I wouldn't say problems, exactly. Just... my wife has had to start reminding me about appointments and chores. I'm just not keeping up the way I used to. And I told you I pulled back from my church friends. It's... well, they actually put me on leave from the senior center, too. I just worry if I can safely go back to caregiving work.
Have you often acted on impulse without considering the consequences?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really... I don't just do things like that.
Have you ever had an episode like the one at the staff meeting before?
No. Not that I remember, anyway. Just... just that one time.
Do you think you have any personality traits that are particularly dominant or noticeable to others?
I... I don't know. I'm just me. I don't really think about it like that. You'd probably have to ask my wife.
Have you ever had any other episodes or behaviors that were similar to what happened at the staff meeting?
I... didn't I just say? No. I haven't had anything else like that happen. It was just... just that one time.
Have you ever had any other times where you acted out of character like you did at the staff meeting?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. Like I said... no. I haven't.
Have you often found yourself indirectly expressing negative feelings through actions instead of directly communicating them?
I... I'm not really sure what you mean by that. If I'm mad about something, I just... I don't know. I don't think I do whatever that is.
Have you ever found yourself doing things that might annoy or upset others without directly telling them you're upset?
I don't... I mean, no. I don't think so. I just try to keep to myself mostly.
Have you ever had any other times in your life where you did something impulsively that surprised you or others?
No... not really. I don't think so. I just... I go to work, I come home. I don't really do things that surprise people.
Have you ever found yourself doing things that might annoy or upset others as a way of dealing with feelings of anger or frustration?
I... I think you just asked me something like that. No. Like I said, I don't... I don't do things just to bother people. If I get frustrated, I just keep quiet and go about my day.
Have you always been someone who pulls back from people when stressed or overwhelmed?
I guess so. Yeah. I just... it's easier that way. I don't really want to be around people when I feel like that.
Has anyone ever told you that you have a dominant or noticeable personality trait?
No... not really. I don't... I don't think people pay that much attention to me, to be honest. I'm just kind of... there. No one's ever said anything like that.
Do you think your behavior at the staff meeting was related to a long-standing pattern of how you interact with others?
I don't... I don't really know what you mean by a pattern. I just... no. I don't think so. I was just at work, doing my job.
